text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hafuu~... What tricky sand to run on. 
Still...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I managed to pull it off, 
I suppose. My results are looking quite 
good~.

The sand at Oi was unfamiliar to Wonder 
Acute. Even so, she gave a truly 
magnificent performance.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so much, really. The 
reason I was able to get such good 
results...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to Trainer putting me 
through rigorous training. Without 
building that up...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"By now, I'd probably be nothing more than 
a dust-covered bun."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"See, didn't I tell you? Trainer-san 
wasn't wrong at all."
choice_data_list:
I'm really glad I could be useful... 
truly...

I'm really glad I could be useful... 
truly...

text_block_list.text: I felt rewarded. And with this great run—

I became convinced that Wonder Acute and 
my training philosophy were a perfect 
match. If the two of us continue forward 
like this...
(Clap clap clap)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...Brava!! Congratulations, Acute-san, 
Trainer-san."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It seems you understand now. Unless the 
lead and supporting roles elevate each 
other, it won't be a masterful 
performance.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan...! You're so right. That 
truly is the way of it.

T.M. Opera O glanced briefly in this 
direction...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, looks like it's almost time. My role 
ends here.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's sad to say goodbye, but the time 
always comes for the curtain to fall. Yes, 
no matter how long the run may be.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san, I conveyed my ideology to this 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"To be frank, I am still unreliable, and 
there are things left unsaid. However, 
that mission—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I entrust it to you. —To my kind-hearted 
Papagena."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There are things you can only learn from 
the Overlord, but conversely, there are 
things you can never learn from her.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's likely something you and 
Trainer-san will discover together moving 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan, I don't really get 
complicated things like that... But...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I reckon me and Trainer'll get along just 
fine. Yep, sure will.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Because they're such a wonderful person.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then very well. I shall be on my 
way.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
May fortune favor wherever their paths 
lead!

Shouting words of gratitude at his 
retreating figure. T.M. Opera O had taught 
them the fundamentals of being a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! You need not come at all! Yet, 
if you insist upon it no matter what, then 
at that time—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For my souvenir, how about bringing back a 
report of your Senior-class GⅠ victory?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"If you show up empty-handed, I'll serve 
up an Overlord Chop right onto the crown 
of your head!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Farewell! And do not forget this—!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That the songstress you are about to 
challenge is undeniably one of the kings!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: One of the... Kings...?

The songstress who seeks to challenge. 
What that points to is...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh? Hey, isn't that girl over 
there...?"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I don't think my eyes are playing 
tricks on me. That was...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aha☆ Thanks for coming to see the Japan 
Dirt Derby today!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"There are lots of wonderful Umamusume on 
the dirt too, right? Please keep cheering 
for us☆"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon...!! I knew it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The race was amazing, wasn't it? The girl 
who seemed to lack confidence before 
looked so much tougher and more dependable 
today.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I thought her footing was on the weaker 
side, so I was a bit worried, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you overcame it just fine☆ Even 
this Ohi dirt track.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, your legs and hips really are 
super important! When stepping, when 
turning, and most of all—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When doing a full-power sprint! Yeah, in 
today's shape...!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Um... Smart Falcon? Who on earth are you 
talking about...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Now, who could it be? The answer is—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
By the end of this year! Maybe we'll 
actually make it in time☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer, things went well for 
today, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Can you really keep up in a game of tag 
with Falco-san as you are right now, I 
wonder?

Wonder Acute had a troubled look on her 
face.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"If the opponent were a Classic-tier girl 
it'd be one thing, but against the famous 
Falco-san, that's just a bit too much..."

Your concern is completely justified. Just 
as T.M. Opera O said—

Right now, Smart Falcon is the undisputed 
dirt queen of the Twinkle Series.

Unless I become much stronger, I won't 
stand a chance.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"To push closer and closer and get one 
step closer to Falco-san... what kind of 
race should I enter, I wonder?"

—I think. There's also the option of 
entering a Senior-class mixed Dirt GⅠ 
early in the autumn, but...

"That might be too heavy of a burden. If 
we want to build up more gradually, maybe 
a GⅡ... no, a GⅢ..."

The race I proposed was a GIII held in 
early October. Senior-class Umamusume 
would be running, but it felt like the 
right level to challenge at this point.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, you found a reasonably priced one. 
Thank you, thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's aim for that first. 
Alright, now that that's settled, off to 
the training camp lodge!
(Vrooooom...)

Taking a night bus back to the training 
camp. Time to dive back into intense 
training for the upcoming Sirius Stakes.
